title: Quantum Variational Approaches to Plasma Equilibrium: Cost Function Design for the Grad-Shafranov Equation
summary: The solution of nonlinear partial differential equations constitutes an important application domain for variational quantum algorithms (VQAs). In this work, we extend the application of VQAs to plasma physics by solving the two-dimensional Grad-Shafranov equation, which describes the equilibrium state of a plasma fluid within the framework of ideal magnetohydrodynamics. For this problem, we develop and investigate two distinct cost function formulations and compare their performance in terms of solution fidelity, convergence speed and quantum resource requirements.
